assessment: The source defines A_CP(t) approximately as S sin(Delta m_d t)-C cos(Delta m_d t), states the Standard Model expectation C approximately zero, predicts S=0.72±0.02 for 1.1<q^2<6.0 GeV^2/c^4, constrains Delta m_d to 0.507±0.002 ps^-1, and reports the six decay-time knots used by the analysis. The card explicitly limits itself to the approximate Standard Model C=0 central relation, preserves both central parameters, time/readout meanings, q^2 and Delta Gamma_d conditions, six-point domain, and exact locators. Deterministic central evaluation is appropriate only under those stated approximations.

issues.detail: The omitted cosine term is justified only by the source’s Standard Model expectation C approximately zero; the case must not be described as the full measured asymmetry model.
The six query times are reported knots of the decay-time acceptance model, not six separately reported asymmetry measurements; the analytic time-dependent relation itself applies at these times.

controls.definition: Time interval between production and decay of the neutral B meson in its rest frame.
controls.name: decay_time

applicability.statement: This is the approximate Standard Model relation for 1.1 < q^2 < 6.0 GeV^2/c^4, using C approximately equal to zero and the central prediction S = 0.72.
The decay-width difference Delta Gamma_d is assumed to be zero.
The queried decay times are the six reported knots of the decay-time acceptance function.

readouts.definition: Difference of the initial anti-B0 and B0 decay rates to the K0S mu+ mu- final state divided by their sum.
readouts.name: time_dependent_cp_asymmetry
